train_refs: 16 identical constant pilot reference shapes, synthetic; never fitted on evaluation frames
rule: All 1400 payload REs for original versus explicit, paired 7 predetermined REs per frame for all three incl strict. nll: raw natural-log mean signed softplus, also per bit position

phase: CFO and two jump cases separated; synthetic ideal reference shapes are common across arms
